observation.source: Cloudflare Worker tail; Console scheduled policy-sync request

conclusion: The scheduled Console sync can still hit the current Free-plan 10ms CPU limit after a prior successful renewal. The failure occurs inside Console after the Gateway dispatches the signed scheduled request; it is not evidence of a Gateway waitUntil, bootstrap-token, Console request-timeout, signature, or Runtime-store failure.
limitations: The snapshot remained below the 300000ms freshness boundary at this readback, but this failed renewal would make it stale if a later renewal does not succeed.
Earlier successful cycles do not establish reliable continuous renewal under the current CPU limit.
